tips_en: I'd recommend starting with Paper 3 (Video-DeepResearch), as it tackles a fundamental reliability bottleneck in multimodal agents (modality bias and knowledge leakage) and delivers the strongest empirical result, clearly outperforming frontier closed models like Claude-4.5-Sonnet and GPT-5 on a rigorous new benchmark. It also connects naturally to Paper 2—both use GRPO-based RL training to instill faithfulness in reasoning pipelines—and to Paper 1, since all three address 'causal faithfulness' under streaming or sequential conditions (temporal consistency in video edits, causally faithful CoT in driving, and tool-grounded exploration in deep research).
tips_zh: 建议先阅读论文3（Video-DeepResearch），因为它针对多模态智能体的一个根本性可靠性瓶颈（模态偏见与知识泄漏）提出了系统性的解法，并在新基准上明显超越 Claude-4.5-Sonnet 与 GPT-5 等前沿闭源模型，实证效果最强。它与论文2有自然的方法学关联——两者都采用基于GRPO的强化学习来提升推理链条的忠实度；同时与论文1也有共同主题：三篇文章都在流式或序列生成场景下追求“因果忠实性”（视频编辑中的时序一致性、自动驾驶中的因果可解释推理、以及深度研究中的工具驱动探索）。
